findings.description: Enumeration: parsed all five pinned list pages with faculty_refresh.parse_directory: faculty=132, courtesy=34, adjunct=13, visiting=1, retired=28 -> 208 distinct people, equal to the 208 required people and to expected_primary_profile_urls. The directory navigation exposes only these five groups (faculty, courtesy, adjunct, visiting, retired), so no group is unchecked.
Counts: regular=115, joint_secondary=7, courtesy=34 (included total=156); excluded: teaching=5, research_only=4, visiting=2, adjunct=13, emeritus/retired=28. Incoming=0.

'Professor of ECE and Associate Head of Teaching and Learning' is a regular ECE professorship with an administrative qualifier, not a teaching-track rank: included as regular. Excluded as teaching/practice: Doosan Back, Steve France, Christopher Lombardo, Carla Zoltowski (Engineering Practice) and Matthew Swabey (Professor of Practice for Microelectronics).
'Visiting Associate Professor of Engineering Practice' is both visiting and practice-track; recorded as excluded/visiting (teaching would be equally excluded).

Listed on the primary ECE faculty list with title 'Basil S. Turner Professor of Engineering' and Materials Engineering address; ECE rank is not named. Recorded as joint_secondary (official ECE roster listing, subtype unspecified). Alternative reading: primary Materials Engineering only; flagged for the human reviewer but not blocking.

Professors whose titles name another unit first and ECE second (Ramani/ME, Scutari/IE, Manfra/Physics, H. Li and Tanaka/AAE, Makur/CS) are on the primary faculty list but the source does not establish regular versus courtesy: recorded joint_secondary rather than guessing regular.

Culurciello and Islam appear under 'Courtesy Faculty - BME/MSE' but no rank is displayed in the directory, pinned profile or live ECE/home profile pages. Included as courtesy on the strength of the explicit official courtesy-faculty heading; professorial rank not independently shown.

Purdue University in Indianapolis professors listed with '(by courtesy)' ECE appointments at the Elmore Family School (Chien, Dos Santos, D. Kim, King, Koskie, J. Lee, Rizkalla, Salama) and Xiaonan Lu (Engineering Technology): included as courtesy under the explicit by-courtesy ECE designation.

Retired-group profile titles that do not say 'Emeritus' (S. Midkiff, R. Givan, J. Gray, Karim El Sharkawy): excluded on the strength of the directory's 'Retired Faculty' heading; recorded as emeritus category since the directory does not supply a retired_working signal.
